mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_energy_data (enterprise_id, factor_id, energy_type, energy_value, emission_value, threshold_value, is_exceeded, collect_time) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{factorId}, #{energyType}, #{energyValue}, #{emissionValue}, #{thresholdValue}, #{isExceeded}, #{collectTime})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.enterprise_id, d.factor_id, d.energy_type, d.energy_value, d.emission_value, d.threshold_value, d.is_exceeded, d.collect_time, d.create_time, e.enterprise_name, e.workshop_name FROM t_energy_data d JOIN t_enterprise e ON e.id = d.enterprise_id WHERE d.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id, d.enterprise_id, d.factor_id, d.energy_type, d.energy_value, d.emission_value, d.threshold_value, d.is_exceeded, d.collect_time, d.create_time, e.enterprise_name, e.workshop_name FROM t_energy_data d JOIN t_enterprise e ON e.id = d.enterprise_id WHERE d.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id, d.enterprise_id, d.factor_id, d.energy_type, d.energy_value, d.emission_value, d.threshold_value, d.is_exceeded, d.collect_time, d.create_time, e.enterprise_name, e.workshop_name FROM t_energy_data d JOIN t_enterprise e ON e.id = d.enterprise_id
ORDER BY d.collect_time DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
